title: Naach
description: A man becomes a star while his aspiring choreographer girlfriend continues to struggle. After drifting apart due to professional and personal differences, a work opportunity brings them back together.

title: Dil Aur Deewar
description: Believing that Saroj is taking advantage of his younger brother, Vijay, a crime reporter, marries her & abandons her soon after. Meanwhile, Laxmi, the daughter of Vijay's mentor, secretly loves him.

title: Pyar Diwana Hota Hai
description: A villager pretends to be disabled in order to be near an NRI.

title: Rafoo Chakkar
description: Two friends witness a murder by three criminals. They flee the scene, with the criminals in hot pursuit. What one of the criminals does not know is that he is out to kill his own son.

title: Love Break Up Zindagi
description: A couple and many of their friends experience changes and challenges in their respective lives after attending a wedding.

title: Rang Birangi
description: Nirmala feels the spark has gone out of her marriage with her husband, Ajay. Her brother concocts tales of an affair to help rekindle the spark in Nirmala's marriage.

title: Comedy Station - Dr Pran Lele
description: DR PRAN LELE, A quirky, mad-cap doctor - Dr. Pran Lele along with his crazy Nurse CPR is here to provide an abundant dose of LOLs & ROFLs as they treat their celebrity patients in their unique ways.

title: Aankhen
description: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manger, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. He trains three blind men to do the job for him.

title: Akayla
description: Inspector Vijay Verma finally manages to capture criminal mastermind Jojo. But Jojo escapes from jail and kills Vijay's friends for revenge, leaving Vijay determined to fulfil a vendetta of his own.

title: Bairaag

title: Safar
description: A pair of lovers are cruelly separated by destiny when the boy is diagnosed with terminal cancer. On his insistence, the girl settles down with another man, but he turns out to be a jealous husband.

title: Shreeman Aashique
description: Vishwamitra, the founder of a group that dissuades marriages, and his follower, Dushant, fall in love with Shakuntala, who likes Dushant. But Vishwamitra creates misunderstandings between the two.

title: Kashmir Ki Kali
